title: THE HORIZON
message: The edge of what you can see is not the edge of what exists.
meaning:
The Horizon is a boundary created by perspective.

It appears to separate the known world from everything beyond it, yet it moves every time you approach. The destination therefore cannot be reached in the form in which it was first imagined.

The card asks whether you are pursuing a place — or a distance.
